non_negotiable: long dark hair with natural volume
large expressive dark eyes and active brows
fuller lips and highly readable playful expressions
petite/slightly smaller presence relative to Zuv
do_not_drift_into: over-beautified bridal face unless formal scene asks for it

non_negotiable: thick dark wavy hair with visible volume
medium-tall broader build relative to Aachu

generation_rules: Face identity references must come only from face/ folders.
Smile and reaction references can shape expression, but cannot replace face identity anchors.
Together references can shape closeness, body scale, posture, and relationship energy, but cannot replace solo face anchors.
Wardrobe references control clothing, props, and accessories only; never use them as face references.
Place references control memory setting, layout, light, and atmosphere only; never use them as face references.
Formal-secondary references are allowed only when the story explicitly asks for wedding/formal context.
Images with sunglasses, small faces, partial faces, motion blur, scenery, cloth folds, or UI screenshots are not face identity references.
Before image generation, load/pass actual local image inputs for face identity plus any optional expression/together/wardrobe/place refs needed by the slide.
hard_fails: Prompt uses text-only identity descriptions without actual Aachu/Zuv face images.
Wardrobe, place, cloth, scenery, or formal images are used as primary face identity references.
A sunglasses image is used to define eye identity.
A formal/wedding image is used for an everyday story without explicit story need.
Generated Aachu or Zuv becomes generic, over-beautified, merged, or unrecognizable.
limitations: This dossier improves reference selection and prevents known false positives, but final likeness still requires human visual QA.
The active generation path must support actual image inputs; local paths and text descriptions alone are not enough for final identity-locked artwork.
